# Burnly v0.1.8

Fixes the Linux one-line installer published in v0.1.7.

## Highlights

- Fixes Linux installer checksum verification for the launcher icon asset.
- Writes generated release checksums with public asset basenames instead of
  internal `artifacts/...` paths.
- Keeps the Linux installer compatible with older checksum files that already
  contain `artifacts/...` paths.

## Install

### Linux

Run:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/fikrilal/burnly/releases/latest/download/install-linux.sh | sh
```

For a pinned install of this release:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/fikrilal/burnly/releases/download/v0.1.8/install-linux.sh | BURNLY_VERSION=v0.1.8 sh
```

### Windows Preview

Download the Windows x64 installer from this release:

```text
burnly-v0.1.8-windows-x86_64.exe
```

### macOS Preview

Run:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/fikrilal/burnly/releases/latest/download/install-macos.sh | sh
```

For a pinned install of this release:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/fikrilal/burnly/releases/download/v0.1.8/install-macos.sh | BURNLY_VERSION=v0.1.8 sh
```

## Verification

Release artifacts include `SHA256SUMS`. Updater metadata is published as
`latest.json`; `latest-linux.json` is kept as a compatibility alias for older
Linux builds.
